digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup composition and auth
propositions: MCP and review-bot services must compose static deployment/startup config once at service initialization and create a fresh per-request OperationSnapshot for each operation, not re-read ambient config per call
MCP inbound bearer tokens must remain request-scoped transient context via PROXY_IDENTITY ContextVar and never leak into startup snapshots, OperationSnapshot, logs, caches, or subprocess environments
Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub tokens) before accepting work and must not fall back to alternate principals when auth is missing, conflicting, or revoked
Static startup bindings must only be observed after process restart/redeploy; environment/file mutations do not rebind running processes
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must disable telemetry without changing the underlying operation result, while security/load-bearing auth remains fail-closed
Review-bot must thread the startup-composed LLMRuntime through to code review decision logic via CodeReviewRequest and adapter initialization, and optional telemetry cannot override operation results
